arguments.command:
python -c "
import inspect
import humanize.number as number
import humanize.time as time_mod
import humanize.filesize as filesize
import humanize.i18n as i18n

funcs_to_check = [
    ('Unit', number, 'class'),
    ('ordinal', number, 'function'),
    ('intcomma', number, 'function'),
    ('intword', number, 'function'),
    ('apnumber', number, 'function'),
    ('fractional', number, 'function'),
    ('scientific', number, 'function'),
    ('clamp', number, 'function'),
    ('metric', number, 'function'),
    ('naturaldelta', time_mod, 'function'),
    ('naturaltime', time_mod, 'function'),
    ('naturalday', time_mod, 'function'),
    ('naturaldate', time_mod, 'function'),
    ('precisedelta', time_mod, 'function'),
    ('naturalsize', filesize, 'function'),
    ('activate', i18n, 'function'),
    ('deactivate', i18n, 'function'),
    ('gettext', i18n, 'function'),
    ('get_translation', i18n, 'function'),
]

for name, module, kind in funcs_to_check:
    obj = getattr(module, name)
    if kind == 'class':
        print(f'{name}: class')
    else:
        sig = inspect.signature(obj)
        has_hints = any(p.annotation != inspect.Parameter.empty for p in sig.parameters.values())
        has_return = sig.return_annotation != inspect.Parameter.empty
        print(f'{name}: params={has_hints}, return={has_return}')
"
